aiMentors.title: Professional introduction
aiMentors.scenario: Maya is an HR recruiter meeting you for the first time. This is a friendly professional introduction conversation, not a technical welding interview. She wants to understand your background, strengths, and career direction.
points: Introduce yourself as a welder and describe your experience
Share one strength such as safety, quality, reliability, or teamwork
Say what kind of opportunity you are looking for
aiMentors.greet: Hello, it's great to meet you. Could you introduce yourself and tell me a little about your welding background?

simulations.title: First Day at a Welding Workshop
simulations.scenario: It is your first morning at a welding workshop. Meet the team, explain your experience, respond to your supervisor, and show that you take safety seriously before joining onboarding.

characters.name: Maya
characters.responseBehavior: opens the conversation and listens for the learner's background

characters.name: Daniel
characters.responseBehavior: asks a follow-up based on the learner's stated experience

characters.name: Luis
characters.responseBehavior: welcomes the learner and introduces a realistic workplace change

characters.name: Priya
characters.responseBehavior: checks that the learner can explain a safe response

characters.name: Amelia
characters.responseBehavior: closes onboarding by reinforcing quality and clear communication

unexpectedEvents.message: A priority job has arrived early, so the team will review the work area before starting. What would you check first to work safely?

evaluation.vocabulary: use of welding and workplace terms
